style_en: Vertical 9:16 miniature diorama 3D CG render in an empty white space. Smooth faceless figurines (no eyes, nose or mouth details). Soft shadows, slightly high angle. Mostly white and gray, only key objects red. Keep the top 35% of the frame empty with no heads or objects; place the main subject between 35% and 68% of the height, centered.
avoid_en: logos, brand marks, golden arches, the letter M, Coca-Cola script or logos, any readable text or numbers on cups, tanks, trucks, bottles or signs, faces resembling real people
